// Cervantes curriculum. Some of its sources are secondary, and the durations and the
// C1-C2 domains are the compiler's own synthesis, not CEFR text.

import type { LingoLevel } from '../../types'

export type RoleplayScenario = {
  /** Kebab-case, unique across all levels. */
  id: string
  level: LingoLevel
  title: string
  situation: string
  /** Who the tutor (the model) plays. */
  tutorRole: string
  /** What the learner does in the scene. */
  learnerRole: string
  communicativeFunction: string
  /** CEFR domain, with the topic in parentheses. */
  domain: string
  /** Estimated length in minutes: a range such as "1-2" or a single value such as "5". */
  minutes: string
}

export function scenariosFor(level: LingoLevel): readonly RoleplayScenario[] {
  return ROLEPLAY_SCENARIOS.filter(s => s.level === level)
}

export function scenarioById(id: string): RoleplayScenario | undefined {
  return ROLEPLAY_SCENARIOS.find(s => s.id === id)
}
